output.analysis: The sender, Marguerite Dubois of Pelican Fabrication, is issuing a new RFQ for a list of flanges as listed in an attached two-page PDF document, with a required-by date and specific material and rating requirements ('ASTM A105' and '150# RF') shown in the heading. The email body also requests additional spiral wound gaskets (2 sets of 4" 150# 304 SS/graphite, and 6 sets of 6" 150# 304 SS/graphite). The items in the attachment follow consistent defaults as indicated in the table headers and the heading: all flanges are to be 'ASTM A105' and '150# RF' unless a line states otherwise, but none does, so these defaults apply to all lines. The instructions to quote price and lead time, and provide MTRs, are general and not line-specific. Only the explicit lines from the PDF and the distinct requests in the body are taken as line_items. Totals, instructions, and any repeated or summary info (end of page footers) are not included.
